spanish: Seis días se hará obra, y en el día el séptimo sábado de reposo, santidad a Jehová; todo el que hace obra en día del sábado, morir será muerto.
grammarChanges: Translated untranslated common noun 'shabat' (H7676) as 'sábado' in both occurrences (h02031015007, h02031015015).
Restored hophal passive stem force: 'morirá' -> 'será muerto' (h02031015017).
Removed the unmarked supplied preposition 'de' that stood before the qal infinitive absolute 'morir' (h02031015016).
Replaced the ungrammatical calque 'el haciendo' with 'el que hace' for the definite qal participle; the doer remains the subject (h02031015012).
Replaced 'será hecha' with the reflexive passive 'se hará' for the niphal imperfect (h02031015003), avoiding forced feminine agreement with 'obra'.
readerNote: Chose the reflexive passive 'se hará obra' instead of the periphrastic 'será hecha obra' to keep the niphal's impersonal stem force without forcing Spanish gender agreement with 'obra'.
